design_condition: The centrally placed volume occupies the geometric center of the existing complex, negotiates topographical differences, connects the established axis, and creates differentiated northern and southern outdoor spaces.

positive.statement: The precise placement creates differentiated outdoor spaces between the existing ensembles.
The building naturally connects to the existing connection axis, while pedestrian-prioritized traffic routing is convincingly solved.
The room organization and combinable communal spaces offer a wide range of additional event and usage options.
The atrium creates interesting spatial relationships and promises flowing and flexible teaching.
The room clusters have great synergy potential and prove advantageous spatially and operationally.
The high proportion of glass promises very bright and transparent rooms.
The compact volumetrics support an energy-efficient and sustainable building.

negative.statement: The glazing, especially the skylights, must be checked in detail on an energy and room-climate level.
